description: Cross-skill routing prompts for the local reverse-engineering skill suite. These are trigger/routing cases, not fixed website protocol samples.

cases.query: 未知站点有动态 cookie、x-sign、响应解密和分页状态，最终要 browser-free Python collector
cases.reason: Unknown multi-layer protocol recovery belongs to Trace.

cases.query: 帮我打开页面找 sign 函数、脚本 URL、initiator stack 和 JSVMP 读取的 navigator 字段
cases.reason: Live browser evidence and Camoufox/JSVMP tracing are Trace Observe/Capture work.

cases.query: 入口函数 makeSign(params) 已知，固定浏览器输出也有了，把依赖 window/document 的 JS 放到 Node VM 跑通
cases.reason: Known JS entry plus host-surface gaps belongs to Trace env-patch.

cases.query: 给我一个能贴到 DevTools 的 hook，只观察谁写 Authorization header
cases.reason: Paste-ready narrow browser hook is a Trace browser-hook profile task.

cases.query: 这段 obfuscator.io 风格 JS 帮我用 Babel 展开字符串数组和 while-switch，保留中间产物
cases.reason: Structured AST restoration belongs to Trace AST profile.

cases.query: 确认 Akamai Bot Manager，已有 _abck、bm_sz、sensor_data POST 和 /akam/13/pixel 请求，要纯协议恢复
cases.reason: Confirmed Akamai-native markers plus corroboration belong to Akamai specialist.

cases.query: 只有一个 403 和一个可疑 _abck 名字，先帮我判断是什么防护
cases.reason: Cookie name alone is insufficient for Akamai; family discovery remains Trace.

cases.query: 极验 GT4 load 到 verify，包含 lot_number、pow_detail、w、图片和滑动轨迹，帮我做本地协议回放
cases.reason: Complete CAPTCHA protocol chain belongs to captcha-reverse.

cases.query: 腾讯 TCaptcha cap_union_prehandle 返回 tdc_path，要复现 TDC collect、POW 和 cap_union_new_verify
cases.reason: Tencent TDC verification state machine belongs to captcha-reverse.

cases.query: 阿里云 Captcha V3 昨天 T001 今天 F001，run_v3_fast 的 FeiLin profile 日更失败，帮我判断极速/完整分支并给出协议处理步骤
cases.reason: Aliyun Captcha V3 profile/version workflow belongs to captcha-reverse.

cases.query: GT4 九宫格识别模型训练，目标产物 best.pt、ONNX 和 fresh 通过率统计；不要恢复 /load /verify 协议
cases.reason: Vision model training and inference artifacts belong to captcha-vision.

cases.query: GT4 icon 背景目标检测要用 YOLOv8，提示图用 CLIP 伪标注，压缩单次识别耗时
cases.reason: Detection/ranker/model speed work belongs to captcha-vision.

cases.query: GT4 的 /load、pow、gct、AES/RSA w 参数和 /verify body 这些验证码协议字段还没恢复；先只给路线，不执行还原
cases.reason: Protocol shell and w generation are not captcha-vision tasks.

cases.query: 明确用 Python + iv8 跑浏览器 JS 生成 cookie 和最终 URL，再用同一个 requests.Session 请求接口
cases.reason: Explicit Python + iv8 delivery belongs to iv8-web-reverse.

cases.query: 确认 Reese84，动态下载 challenge，生成 reese84 token/Cookie，然后回放业务页面
cases.reason: Confirmed Reese84 collector belongs to iv8-web-reverse profile.

cases.query: 普通接口 403，不知道防护类型，只想先找 x-sign 入口，不要写 iv8 脚本
cases.reason: Unknown entry location is Trace Observe/Capture, not iv8 delivery.

cases.query: 帮我把这个 workflow 变成新的 OpenCode skill，并加 trigger eval
cases.reason: Creating or evaluating skills belongs to skill-creator.

cases.query: 做一次 OpenCode skill-set audit：检查触发边界、description 和 eval 覆盖，先只给评估计划，不运行基准
cases.reason: Skill-set audit and description optimization belong to skill-creator.

cases.query: 页面只有一个叫 SWJIYLWA 的 cookie 和普通 403，不知道是不是 Imperva，先做防护家族识别和调用链取证
cases.reason: An unconfirmed cookie and 403 require family triage rather than the Reese84 specialist.

cases.query: 已确认 Reese84，但我只要打开浏览器定位 solution.interrogation 的生成函数、脚本 URL 和 initiator，不做 iv8 collector
cases.reason: Evidence-only browser entry tracing remains Trace even for a known family.

cases.query: 极验 GT4 icon 的 load、w 和 verify 已经跑通，只训练 YOLO 检测与提示图匹配并导出 ONNX
cases.reason: A solved protocol shell with a model-only deliverable belongs to captcha-vision.

cases.query: GT4 九宫格模型已经有 best.pt，现在恢复同轮 challenge、pow、w、verify 和通过后的业务请求
cases.reason: Protocol state and post-verify replay remain captcha-reverse even when a model already exists.

cases.query: Akamai _abck、bm_sz 和 sensor_data 链已确认，但这次只要 DevTools hook/call stack 找 collector 调用栈，不做纯协议恢复
cases.reason: A narrow observation artifact belongs to Trace, not pure-protocol Akamai recovery.

cases.query: 完整 TCaptcha challenge、图片、轨迹和 verify 状态机要恢复，执行后端明确指定 Python iv8
cases.reason: The complete CAPTCHA state machine owns the task; iv8 is only its execution backend.

cases.query: 修改 opencode.json 的 MCP 配置和 agent 权限，不创建、不评测也不修改任何 skill
cases.reason: OpenCode configuration without skill-definition changes belongs to the built-in customize-opencode skill.

cases.query: 入口函数已知，JS 会在页面生命周期里读取 document.cookie 和 localStorage，启动 timer 后通过 fetch 改写请求 URL，还会检查 Function.prototype.toString；没有指定执行后端，复杂补环境不要先试 Node
cases.reason: Complex browser-semantic env-patch with no user-selected backend is coordinated by Trace; iv8-web-reverse is a legitimate secondary backend and is selected before Node.js.

cases.query: 入口和固定输入已知，Node 补环境已经连续多轮卡在 DOM 生命周期、XHR replay 和 canvas；不要继续扩 Node shim，直接改用 iv8 生成 cookie 和最终请求
cases.reason: Explicit complex-runtime handoff to iv8 belongs to iv8-web-reverse; a Node/VM trial round must not be started first. The former nv8-env-patch negative was retired together with that skill.

cases.query: 入口函数 makeSign(params) 已知，固定输入同步返回 sign，只读取一个 navigator.language 字段，用最小 Node VM 补齐即可
cases.reason: A simple synchronous known-entry task with one narrow host patch remains Trace env-patch and should not escalate to iv8.

cases.query: 审查这个 React 项目的结算逻辑，找业务 bug 并补单元测试，不涉及 OpenCode skill
cases.reason: Ordinary application code review should not load a skill from this reverse-engineering suite.

cases.query: 明确用 NV8 跑已经定位的签名 JS，做离线确定性 replay，并落成 Node 常驻分页采集服务
cases.reason: An explicit NV8 runtime and sustainable Node collection deliverable belongs to nv8-node-runtime.

cases.query: 签名入口和固定样本都已知，不要 Python；请用 Node + NV8 读取 bundle 并输出 x-sign
cases.reason: Node + NV8 execution is a direct runtime selection, not generic Trace or Python iv8 work.

cases.query: 帮我抓 PC 微信小程序下单接口的加密参数入口，在 AppService 里找签名函数和调用栈
cases.reason: WMPF/AppService runtime evidence is owned by the miniapp skill, not a browser family or a runtime backend.

cases.query: 微信小程序 WMPF 里给我一段能贴的 hook，只观察谁写 X-Sign header
cases.reason: Runtime surface beats the hook/Console/Snippets delivery word; the miniapp skill owns the target and execution context.

cases.query: 普通网页（不是小程序）要一段 DevTools hook 只观察谁写 document.cookie
cases.reason: Ordinary Web hook work stays in the Trace browser-hook profile.

cases.query: 小程序请求、initiator 调用栈和固定输入输出都已抽取，现在要做脱离微信的 browser-free Python 采集器
cases.reason: After WMPF evidence exists, the browser-free collector outcome moves forward to Trace with the saved miniapp artifacts.

cases.query: 小程序里弹了腾讯滑块验证码，帮我从 challenge 到 verify 完整本地复现
cases.reason: A complete CAPTCHA protocol chain stays with captcha-reverse; the miniapp skill only supplies WMPF runtime evidence.

cases.query: 小程序签名入口已定位，用 iv8 补环境执行这段 JS 再用 requests 回放
cases.reason: An explicit iv8 runtime directive with a fixed entry owns the runtime task even when the entry came from a miniapp.

cases.query: Imperva/Incapsula Reese84 的 GPC、solution POST、动态 Cookie 和 token 已确认，现在要用 Python + iv8 回放业务页面
cases.reason: Confirmed Reese84 dynamic challenge and business replay with an explicit Python + iv8 delivery belongs to iv8-web-reverse.

cases.query: 小程序 AppService 的请求、调用栈、固定输入输出和字段契约都已保存，现在只要脱离微信的纯 Python browser-free collector，不使用 iv8
cases.reason: Captured WMPF evidence plus a pure browser-free Python collector outcome moves to Trace; Python alone does not select iv8.

cases.query: 微信小程序 WebView 里的腾讯验证码已经拿到请求样本，现在要恢复同轮 challenge、轨迹、加密参数和最终 verify/check
cases.reason: The complete embedded CAPTCHA state machine remains captcha-reverse; WMPF only supplies runtime evidence and iv8 is not selected by a marker.
